::: {.callout-note}
## Scope of this page

**What:** 2025 line-point resurvey of **1991 EIR / 1999 Revegetation Plan** mitigation parcels—cover and composition against Table 2 goals [@LADWP1999].

**Why:** Separate from Laws Type E (2003). Partners need a transparent path from segment hits → site goals. Pages marked *(draft)* elsewhere are prototypes; this report is the working 1999-plan monitoring product.
:::

## Purpose

**Parcels:** IND105, IND123, IND131N/S, BLK16E, TIN054, BGP160E/W, BIS097, and LAW118 (1999-plan context)—not the Type E transfer dashboard ([Laws](index.html) / [reference](reference.html)).

**Cover math:** We use **species hit counts only** from the 2025 workbook; staff `%COV` / `%COMP` columns are ignored. Percent cover = `hits / n_possible_hits × 100`, with `n_possible_hits = segment length (m) / 0.5`.^[Segment lengths are GIS post-to-post distances (`data/transect_segment_denominators.csv`) when sheets omit total points. Protocol implies first-hit every 0.5 m; some years may have been tallied per segment without locations—field practice still being confirmed.]

Goal outcomes: @tbl-goal-summary · map: @fig-overview-map.

## 1999 Revegetation Plan goals

**What the Plan requires** [@LADWP1999]: site-specific live native perennial **cover**, **composition** (species contributing to cover), and **recruitment / sustainability** (≥25% of vegetation cover as natural recruits ≥3 years old).

**What this report scores:** cover and composition from 2025 LPI (with the master-workbook CI rules below). **Sustainability is not scored from LPI alone** here; the LADWP aerial pilot is summarized next as context for that third criterion.

Goals below follow **Table 2** (*2021–22 Mitigation Projects and Status*).

### LADWP proposal — aerial recruitment / sustainability (2026)

**What:** A remote-sensing workflow (high-res imagery + LiDAR → live/dead/bare → interannual overlap) to estimate recruit share of live cover on IND105.

**Why summarize it here:** The Plan’s 25% recruit rule needs an operational definition; this pilot is the current LA proposal. Full deck remains local (`reveg1999plan-docs/`); County dual-track notes in `docs/1999plan_sustainability_monitoring_proposal.md`.

**Why IND105:** cover and composition already met—useful for testing sustainability; **IND123** is also of interest for full completion.

#### Workflow (slides 7–8)

1. Establish “current” vegetation from **0.05 m** imagery + **LiDAR** (August **2022**).  
2. Georeference (spline).  
3. Object recognition (**eCognition**).  
4. **Random Forest** → Bare Ground / Live Vegetation / Dead Vegetation.  
5. Merge and explode live polygons.  
6. Superimpose year-of-interest live polygons on a prior year.  
7. **New recruits** = no overlap with prior live cover, **or** overlapping area **&lt; 10%** of the polygon (also: previously undetectable, **&lt; 0.3 m**).

#### Recruitment metric and pilot scores

**What:** \(R\) = (recruit live area) / (total live vegetation cover), compared to Plan **≥25%** of vegetation cover—not parcel area [@LADWP1999].

| Epoch | Live cover | Recruit cover | Recruit % of cover | vs 25% |
|-------|------------|---------------|--------------------|--------|
| 2014 vs 2009 | 14.0% | 1.93% | **13.7%** | below |
| 2017 vs 2014 (unadjusted) | 38.9% | 17.0% | **43.8%** | above |
| 2017 adjusted (×0.74 + persist to 2022) | 28.9% | 14.4% | **49.7%** | above |
| 2022 vs 2017 | 11.1% | 1.27% | **11.5%** | below |

```{r}
#| label: fig-ladwp-recruit-2022
#| fig-cap: "New recruitment in 2022 vs 2017 live cover (LADWP): non-intersecting and small-overlap recruit polygons; recruit share 11.5% of 2022 live cover."
#| out-width: "90%"
#| eval: !expr file.exists("images/ladwp-sustainability-2026/10_recruitment_2022.jpeg")
knitr::include_graphics("images/ladwp-sustainability-2026/10_recruitment_2022.jpeg")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-ladwp-recruit-2017-adj
#| fig-cap: "Adjusted 2017 recruitment (LADWP): annual correction and persistence filter vs 2022 live/dead; recruit share 49.7% of adjusted cover."
#| out-width: "100%"
#| eval: !expr all(file.exists(c("images/ladwp-sustainability-2026/14_adjusted_2017_a.jpeg", "images/ladwp-sustainability-2026/14_adjusted_2017_b.jpeg")))
knitr::include_graphics(c(
  "images/ladwp-sustainability-2026/14_adjusted_2017_a.jpeg",
  "images/ladwp-sustainability-2026/14_adjusted_2017_b.jpeg"
))
```

**Annual issue (slide 13):** 2017 RS cannot separate annuals; IND106 T10/T12 (within IND105) had **25.7%** annual hits → scale cover × **0.743**; keep non-intersecting polygons that overlap **2022 live or dead**.

**Caveats from LA watershed resources staff:** Annuals **inflate recruitment area**. If credited as recruitment in 2017 but empty in 2022, drop from the 25% share (annual signal; perennial mortality is an alternate assumption). Lateral growth ≠ recruitment on LPI alone; sample ≠ whole site without a sampling frame.

#### Recommendations (slide 17)

1. Acquire **high-resolution remote sensing (~0.05 m / 5 cm)** **with LiDAR** every **three to five years**. *(Deck text says “&lt; 0.05 cm” — treat as typo for 0.05 m, matching the 2022 acquisition.)*  
2. Conduct **ground monitoring concurrently** with RS acquisition.

**Going forward (ICWD):** treat **2022** as baseline; compare expected **2024 3DEP LiDAR** to 2022 and to **2025** transects; refine baseline before the next high-res flight.

**Compliance method** (from `LADWP 1991 EIR REVEGETATION DATA-MASTER.xlsm`): cover is met when the **upper 80% confidence interval** of mean transect cover reaches **90% of the Table 2 cover goal** (`upper CI80 ≥ 0.9 × goal`). Species composition is met when observed richness reaches **75% of the Table 2 species goal**. The 80% CI uses `mean + t₀.₉,ₙ₋₁ × SD / √n` across transects (or segments, for 2025).

This report compares **2025 live native perennial cover**, **upper 80% CI**, and **native perennial species with ≥3 hits** to those targets. Cover and species metrics use the same perennial filter as the LADWP master workbook (`Lifecycle` contains “Perennial”). Parcels with missing segment lengths (denominators) are marked incomplete.

**Parcel boundaries:** AGOL polygons only — no transect buffering. Most parcels use `mitigation_sites.shp`; **LAW118** uses `mitigation_view_polygons.geojson`; **TIN054** uses the experimental plot in `data/gis/TIN054.json`. **TIN054 transect geometry is TBD** (current post pairing draws incorrectly; map left blank until remapped).

## Data loading

```{r load-data}
library(dplyr)
library(DT)
library(leaflet)
library(sf)
library(readr)
library(knitr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

source("code/parse_reveg1999plan_workbook.R")
source("code/parse_reveg1999_master_workbook.R")
source("code/reveg1999plan_maps.R")

data1999 <- load_reveg1999plan_data()
write_reveg1999plan_outputs(data1999)

master_data <- load_reveg1999_master_data()
write_reveg1999_master_outputs(master_data)

hits <- data1999$hits
meta <- data1999$metadata
species_attr <- read_csv("data/species.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

segment_cover <- summarise_reveg1999_segment_cover(hits, species_attr)
posts_sf <- load_reveg1999_transect_posts()
segment_points <- build_reveg1999_segment_points(segment_cover, posts_sf)
segment_lines <- build_reveg1999_segment_lines(segment_cover, posts_sf)
boundaries <- load_reveg1999_parcel_boundaries()

missing_by_parcel <- hits |>
  group_by(parcel) |>
  summarise(
    n_segment_keys = n_distinct(segment_key),
    segments_missing_denom = n_distinct(segment_key[is.na(n_possible_hits)]),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

parcel_metrics_calc <- compute_reveg1999_parcel_metrics(hits, species_attr) |>
  fix_parcel_metrics_denominators(hits)

parcel_metrics <- tibble(parcel = sort(unique(hits$parcel))) |>
  left_join(REVEG1999_PARCEL_GOALS, by = "parcel") |>
  left_join(meta |> select(parcel, survey_date), by = "parcel") |>
  left_join(missing_by_parcel, by = "parcel") |>
  left_join(parcel_metrics_calc, by = "parcel", suffix = c("", "_calc")) |>
  mutate(
    assessment_complete = if_else(
      is.na(assessment_complete),
      segments_missing_denom == 0L,
      assessment_complete
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(parcel)

parcel_list <- parcel_metrics$parcel
```

## Goal assessment summary

Compliance against Table 2 cover and composition criteria is shown in @tbl-goal-summary.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-goal-summary
#| tbl-cap: "2025 monitoring versus 1999 Plan goals (upper 80% CI cover test and species composition)."
#| column: screen

goal_display <- parcel_metrics |>
  mutate(
    cover_status = case_when(
      is.na(assessment_complete) | !assessment_complete ~ "Incomplete",
      cover_met ~ "Met",
      TRUE ~ "Not met"
    ),
    composition_status = case_when(
      is.na(assessment_complete) | !assessment_complete ~ "Incomplete",
      composition_met ~ "Met",
      TRUE ~ "Not met"
    ),
    overall_status = case_when(
      is.na(assessment_complete) | !assessment_complete ~ "Incomplete",
      overall_met ~ "Met",
      TRUE ~ "Not met"
    ),
    live_native_cover_pct = round(live_native_cover_pct, 1),
    upper_ci80_pct = round(upper_ci80_pct, 1),
    target_cover_pct = round(target_cover_pct, 2),
    target_species_richness = round(target_species_richness, 2),
    mean_segment_length_m = round(mean_segment_length_m, 1)
  ) |>
  select(
    parcel, survey_date, n_segments, mean_segment_length_m,
    live_native_cover_pct, upper_ci80_pct, target_cover_pct, cover_status,
    n_species_3plus, target_species_richness, composition_status,
    overall_status, segments_missing_denom
  )

datatable(
  goal_display,
  colnames = c(
    "Parcel",
    "Survey date",
    "Segments",
    "Mean seg. (m)",
    "Cover (%)",
    "Upper 80% CI",
    "Cover target",
    "Cover status",
    "Species ≥3",
    "Species target",
    "Composition",
    "Overall",
    "Missing denom."
  ),
  rownames = FALSE,
  elementId = "goal-summary-table",
  options = list(
    pageLength = 15,
    scrollX = TRUE,
    scrollCollapse = TRUE,
    autoWidth = FALSE,
    columnDefs = list(
      list(width = "76px", targets = 0),
      list(width = "100px", targets = 1),
      list(width = "76px", targets = 2),
      list(width = "92px", targets = 3),
      list(width = "76px", targets = 4),
      list(width = "92px", targets = 5),
      list(width = "92px", targets = 6),
      list(width = "100px", className = "dt-status-col", targets = 7),
      list(width = "80px", targets = 8),
      list(width = "100px", targets = 9),
      list(width = "100px", className = "dt-status-col", targets = 10),
      list(width = "92px", className = "dt-status-col", targets = 11),
      list(width = "96px", targets = 12)
    )
  )
)
```

## Revegetation sites

Each section shows the mitigation site boundary, transect segment lines, labeled posts (2025 cover), a cover trend plot (Table 2 goal, 90% compliance threshold, upper 80% CI), summary statistics, and goal status.

TOC / jump labels use: **⚠️** = cover + composition met (2025), sustainability not yet demonstrated; **❔** = assessment incomplete; no mark = cover and/or composition not met.

```{r parcel-nav, results='asis'}
toc_mark <- function(p) {
  m <- parcel_metrics |> filter(parcel == p)
  if (nrow(m) != 1 || isFALSE(m$assessment_complete[1]) || is.na(m$overall_met[1])) {
    return("\u2753 ") # ❔ incomplete
  }
  if (isTRUE(m$overall_met[1])) {
    return("\u26a0\ufe0f ") # ⚠️ met cover/comp; sustainability TBD
  }
  ""
}

parcel_nav <- paste0(
  "[", vapply(parcel_list, toc_mark, character(1)), parcel_list, "](#",
  tolower(parcel_list), ")",
  collapse = " · "
)
cat("**Jump to parcel:** ", parcel_nav, "\n\n", sep = "")
```
```{r parcel-profiles, results='asis', fig.width=7, fig.height=5, fig.show='asis'}
goal_icon <- function(met) {
  if (is.na(met)) {
    return("—")
  }
  if (met) "\u2705" else "\u274c"
}

for (p in parcel_list) {
  m <- parcel_metrics |> filter(parcel == p)
  mrow <- if (nrow(m) == 1) m else NULL
  meta_row <- meta |> filter(parcel == p)

  # Emoji in heading flows into Quarto TOC (sidebar)
  cat("\n\n### ", toc_mark(p), p, " {#", tolower(p), "}\n\n", sep = "")

  if (nrow(meta_row) == 1) {
    cat(
      "**Survey date:** ", format(meta_row$survey_date[1], "%Y-%m-%d"),
      " · **Quad:** ", coalesce(meta_row$quad[1], "—"),
      " · **Mitigation acres (AGOL):** ",
      if (nrow(boundaries |> filter(parcel == p)) > 0) {
        round(boundaries |> filter(parcel == p) |> pull(acres), 1)
      } else {
        "—"
      },
      "\n\n",
      sep = ""
    )
  }

  if (!is.null(mrow) && mrow$assessment_complete) {
    cat(
      "| Metric | 2025 | Target | Status |\n",
      "|--------|------|--------|--------|\n",
      "| Live native cover (parcel mean) | ", mrow$live_native_cover_pct, "% | ",
      round(mrow$cover_goal_pct, 1), "% (Table 2) | — |\n",
      "| Upper 80% CI (segment mean) | ",
      if_else(is.na(mrow$upper_ci80_pct), "—", paste0(round(mrow$upper_ci80_pct, 1), "%")),
      " | ", round(mrow$target_cover_pct, 2), "% | ", goal_icon(mrow$cover_met), " |\n",
      "| Native species (≥3 hits) | ", mrow$n_species_3plus, " | ",
      round(mrow$target_species_richness, 2), " | ", goal_icon(mrow$composition_met), " |\n",
      "| **Overall** | | | **", if (mrow$overall_met) "Met" else "Not met", "** |\n\n",
      sep = ""
    )
  } else {
    cat(
      "**Assessment incomplete** — ",
      coalesce(mrow$segments_missing_denom[1], NA), " segment(s) lack GIS length/denominator.\n\n",
      sep = ""
    )
  }

  cat("**Map:** parcel boundary (grey), transect segments (lines), and posts colored by 2025 percent cover.\n\n")

  if (identical(p, "TIN054")) {
    cat(
      "::: {.callout-note}\n\n",
      "## TIN054 transect map — TBD\n\n",
      "Post/segment pairing is not reliable yet, so the site map is omitted. ",
      "Cover tables and trend still show; geometry will be added when the layout is confirmed.\n\n",
      ":::\n\n",
      sep = ""
    )
  } else {
    p_map <- plot_reveg1999_parcel_map(
      p, boundaries, segment_points, mrow, segment_lines
    )
    if (!is.null(p_map)) {
      print(p_map)
    } else {
      cat("_Map unavailable for this parcel (missing posts or boundary)._\n\n")
    }
  }

  cat("\n\n**Cover trend:** mean cover with upper 80% CI; dashed line = Table 2 goal; red line = 90% compliance threshold.\n\n")

  p_trend <- plot_reveg1999_parcel_cover_history(p, master_data$parcel_summary, mrow)
  print(p_trend)
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## Segment cover (all parcels)

Segment-level cover (@tbl-segment-cover) uses GIS post-to-post lengths as the hit denominator.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-segment-cover
#| tbl-cap: "2025 segment-level cover computed from hits and GIS segment length."

segment_cover |>
  filter(!is.na(n_possible_hits)) |>
  mutate(
    length_m = round(length_m, 1),
    segment_cover_pct = round(segment_cover_pct, 2)
  ) |>
  arrange(parcel, segment_key) |>
  datatable(
    rownames = FALSE,
    options = list(pageLength = 20, scrollX = TRUE)
  )
```

## Historical monitoring (1999–2017)

Longitudinal cover summaries parsed from `data/raw/LADWP 1991 EIR REVEGETATION DATA-MASTER.xlsm`. Cover compliance uses the same upper 80% CI test against 90% of the Table 2 cover goal.

Historical parcel summaries from the LADWP master workbook appear in @tbl-historical-cover; trends are shown in @fig-historical-cover.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-historical-cover
#| tbl-cap: "Historical parcel cover summaries from the LADWP master workbook."

master_display <- master_data$parcel_summary |>
  filter(!is.na(mean_cover_pct)) |>
  mutate(
    mean_cover_pct = round(mean_cover_pct, 1),
    upper_ci80_pct = round(upper_ci80_pct, 1),
    target_cover_pct = round(target_cover_pct, 2),
    cover_met = if_else(cover_met, "Met", "Not met"),
    species_richness_met = if_else(species_richness_met, "Met", "Not met")
  ) |>
  select(
    parcel, survey_year, n_transects, mean_cover_pct, upper_ci80_pct,
    target_cover_pct, cover_met, species_richness, target_species_richness,
    species_richness_met
  ) |>
  arrange(parcel, survey_year)

datatable(
  master_display,
  rownames = FALSE,
  options = list(pageLength = 20, scrollX = TRUE)
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-historical-cover
#| fig-cap: "Mean transect cover by survey year (LADWP master workbook and 2025 resurvey)."
#| fig-height: 5

cover_2025 <- parcel_metrics |>
  filter(assessment_complete) |>
  transmute(
    parcel,
    survey_year = 2025L,
    mean_cover_pct = mean_segment_cover_pct
  )

historical_plot_data <- bind_rows(
  master_data$parcel_summary |>
    select(parcel, survey_year, mean_cover_pct),
  cover_2025
) |>
  filter(!is.na(mean_cover_pct))

label_data <- historical_plot_data |>
  group_by(parcel) |>
  slice_max(survey_year, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup()

ggplot(historical_plot_data, aes(x = survey_year, y = mean_cover_pct, color = parcel, group = parcel)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = survey_year == 2025), size = 2) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 17, `FALSE` = 19), guide = "none") +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = label_data,
    aes(label = parcel, color = parcel),
    size = 2.5,
    show.legend = FALSE,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.35,
    segment.size = 0.2,
    force = 1.5,
    direction = "both",
    seed = 42
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(historical_plot_data$survey_year))) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(
    x = "Survey year",
    y = "Mean transect cover (%)",
    color = "Parcel",
    caption = "Per-parcel plots in the sections above show Table 2 goal, 90% threshold, and upper 80% CI."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 60, 5.5, 5.5)
  )
```

## Data downloads

Processed outputs in `data/processed/`:

-   `reveg1999plan_hits_long.csv`
-   `reveg1999plan_parcel_metadata.csv`
-   `reveg1999_master_transect_cover.csv`
-   `reveg1999_master_parcel_summary.csv`

Denominator lookup: `data/transect_segment_denominators.csv` (`python3 code/build_transect_segment_denominators.py`).

Parcel boundaries: `mitigation_sites.shp` (primary), `mitigation_view_polygons.geojson` (LAW118), `TIN054.json` (experimental plot). Transect posts: `TIN054_tpost_transects.json` → `TIN054_transect_posts.csv`.
